_notes.frame: World metres, Z up, origin = paving under table centre (data/frame.json).
_notes.hex: Hex lattice fitted to dark joint lines in a ground-plane mosaic of the reference renders (scripts/analyze_ground_ortho.py back-projects each view onto z=0; table-top occlusion masked). Grid search + 2 refinements maximising joint darkness under the lattice edges. across_flats is the centre spacing (slab + joint); rotation_deg is the lattice u axis; slab flat sides face +-u. Uncertainty ~ +-1 cm spacing, +-1 deg, +-1.5 cm phase; the real paving is hand-laid so local joints wander by 2-4 cm (esp. x<-0.8, y<-0.4).
_notes.paving_boundary: Cells with >=45% pale-paving pixels (inner part, 3 cm from edges) are paved; cells under the table top (rho<0.95) are paved by construction. Boundary radius per 15-degree sector = midpoint between outermost paved and innermost unpaved centre, fitted by a 4-harmonic Fourier series r(phi) = a0 + sum(ak cos k phi + bk sin k phi). 'misclassified' lists cells the smooth boundary disagrees with. Lawn creeps over the outer slabs.
_notes.paving_level: Median z of splat centres at rho 0.85-1.4 m |z|<5 cm (spread = p90-p10).
_notes.lawn_plane: Least-squares plane z = c0 + c1 x + c2 y through the 5th-percentile splat height of 0.5 m cells with 2.1<rho<4.5 (lawn soil/grass base); residual std reported.
_notes.lawn_outline: Green low splats (z<0.16) on a 10 cm grid, closed + largest component + paving disc, then the outermost radius along 72 rays fitted by an 8-harmonic Fourier series. Uncertain (+-25 cm) where shrubs overhang the lawn edge (x<-2,y<-1 and x>3). Grass/lawn mask is extended 0.1-0.45 m beyond the fitted outline so the lawn meets the path strips (the green-splat outline stops short where path splats begin); terrace and pond masks clip it.
_notes.paths: Grey concrete edging/path strips read from gridded ground mosaics (outputs/derived/ground/crop_*.png) as polylines (x, y) with width; +-5 cm. hero_path = strip behind the lawn at the top of the hero view; far_path = strip between lawn and pond grates (opposite view); left_path = strip along x~-6.2. hero_path re-expressed in the 18-degree garden frame: centre b -3.25 (scan low band b -3.1..-3.45), a -1.6..4.6.
_notes.terrace: Raised bed terrace measured in the structures' garden frame (rotated 18 deg about Z: a = x cos + y sin, b = -x sin + y cos). 15th-percentile splat z vs b for a 1..3: ~0 at b -3.2..-3.4 (path), kerb at b -3.55, 0.17 at b -3.8, 0.20 -4.2, 0.26 -4.6, 0.29 -5.0, 0.31-0.33 beyond. Modelled as a kerb step to z_start then a linear rise to z_end, capped at z_max. The steps notch (a -0.33..0.47, b -3.45..-4.8) is kept at path level for the structures' concrete flight. Pond: box a -3..1.55, b 3.75..5.10 lowered to floor_z with a water plane at water_z (scan p5 -0.05, p50 0.0 incl. grates). The terrace step is centred under the STRUCTURES concrete edging (b -3.50, +-0.04) so no ground face shows in front of it; ground has no kerb mesh of its own. Rear yard (x -1.6..0.5, y -8.2..-10.6, under the STRUCTURES bin and wheelbarrow): no splats below z 0.35 there (the ground is hidden by props/wall), so the terrace plateau z 0.31 is extended to y -10.7 (uncertain +-0.1); dark soil + gravel, sparse weeds.
_notes.lawn_tone: Cubic polynomial fields in (x/4, y/4) fitted to green ground-mosaic pixels (rho>2.1 m): 'tone' = brightness / lawn median (drives per-tuft value), 'dry' = yellowness offset (drives gr_dry). Includes shading by the tree/shrubs, so it is a rendered-appearance field, not albedo.
_notes.palette: sRGB 0-255 of the reference renders over slab interiors, joints (|edge|<6 mm) and lawn ring; these include overcast lighting and are targets for rendered appearance, not albedo.
